housing.summary: Canberra is Australia's capital with a tight rental market. A 1-bedroom apartment in the city centre typically rents for approximately AUD 450–550 per week. ACT's Residential Tenencies Act caps the bond at 4 weeks rent. Primary rental portals are realestate.com.au and domain.com.au.

banking.summary: To open a bank account in Australia, new arrivals typically need a valid passport, proof of Australian address, and a Tax File Number (TFN). CommBank allows account opening up to 14 days before arrival. ANZ and NAB also serve new residents.
required_docs: Valid passport (original required for in-branch ID verification within 20 days)

schools.summary: Canberra has international schools including IB-curriculum institutions. The national school directory myschool.edu.au lists all ACT schools. ACT state schools fall under the ACT Education Directorate.

legal_admin.summary: Visa holders in Australia must notify the Department of Home Affairs of any address changes. New residents should register with myGov (my.gov.au) to link ATO, Medicare, and Centrelink services.
legal_admin.registration_step: Register with myGov; notify Home Affairs of address changes

tax_finance.summary: All workers and income earners in Australia require a Tax File Number (TFN) from the Australian Taxation Office (ATO). Apply online for free at ato.gov.au. The ATO is headquartered in Canberra.

transport.summary: Canberra public transport is operated by Transport Canberra using the MyWay+ card system. The network covers buses and the light rail (Canberra Metro). Monthly pass pricing was not retrievable from currently accessible pages. Overseas licence holders in ACT must convert to an ACT licence via Access Canberra. Medicare registration via Services Australia.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: Overseas licence holders must convert to an ACT driver's licence via Access Canberra. Typically required within 3 months of taking up ACT residency.
transport.healthcare_registration: Eligible visa holders enrol in Medicare at Services Australia offices or online via servicesaustralia.gov.au/medicare.
